newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SOCCER-WILLIAMS RECALLED TO SOUTH AFRICAN SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WILLIAMS RECALLED TO SOUTH AFRICAN SQUAD.

text.p: Mark Williams, hero of South Africa's African Nations Cup victory last year, was recalled to the national squad on Tuesday for next week's internationals against the Netherlands and Zambia.
Williams scored both goals for South Africa in their 2-0 win over Tunisia in last year's final but has not played for the national team since last September.
Injuries and a collapsed contract with Corinthians in Brazil saw him drop out of the national set-up.
South Africa play a friendly against the Netherlands in Johannesburg on June 4 and take on Zambia in a key World Cup qualifier at the same venue four days later.
There is also a return to the team for defender Gavin Lane, who missed the 2-1 defeat by England in Manchester last Saturday because of a rib injury, and Turkish-based striker Pollen Ndlanya.

Coach Clive Barker also named 19-year-old Benedict McCarthy in the squad for the first time. McCarthy recently signed for Ajax Amsterdam after finishing top goal scorer in last month's African under-20 championship in Morocco.
The South African coach is expected to field an experimental team against the Dutch and play his first choice side against Zambia on June 8.
A win for South Africa in that match would virtually assure the country of a place in the World Cup finals for the first time.

Defenders: Bradley Carnell (Wits University), Mark Fish (Lazio, Italy), Gavin Lane (Orlando Pirates), Sizwe Motaung (Tenerife, Spain), Bradley Muir (Manning Rangers), David Nyathi (Tenerife, Spain), Andrew Rabutla (Jomo Cosmos), Lucas Radebe (Leeds, England), Neil Tovey (Kaizer Chiefs).
